title: Batch an iterable
hints: Turn the input into an iterator once with it = iter(iterable); repeated islice(it, n) calls then continue where the last one stopped.
tuple(islice(it, n)) gives the next batch; an empty tuple means the input is exhausted, so return from the generator.
Because a generator body does not run until next(), do the `if n < 1: raise ValueError` in a normal function and `return _batches(iter(iterable), n)` where _batches is the generator.
